name: Rose-Thorn-Bud
description: Team members share a rose (something good), a thorn (a difficulty) and a bud (something with potential). A gentle way to get to know each other and share honestly.

columns.name: Rose
columns.prompt: What went well or made you happy?

columns.name: Bud
columns.prompt: What new idea or chance do you see growing?

mood.energized: Light and open, easy to start.
mood.tense: Thorns can be shared in a safe and kind way.

goal.bond: Sharing roses and thorns builds trust.

checkInQuestion: What is one rose from your week, something that made you smile?
facilitationTips: Start with roses so the mood is positive before you move to thorns.
Let each person read their own notes aloud, without interruption.
Thank people for sharing thorns; do not try to fix them right away.
